'''Ram Tah''' is a ship Engineer based at '''[[Phoenix Base]]''' in the '''[[Meene]]''' system. A widely travelled collector and researcher, he specialises in limpet controllers, defensive utility modules, and Guardian technology.<ref name="edwiki-ram">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Ram_Tah Ram Tah], Elite Dangerous Wiki. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

His conventional workshop services reach Grade 5 for several limpet controllers and utility modules. Live also includes Extended Cargo Rack engineering for compatible Merc modules and the Anti-Guardian Zone Resistance modification for Guardian technology.<ref name="inara-ram">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/18/ Ram Tah — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

== Location ==

* '''System:''' [[Meene]]
* '''Body:''' Meene AB 5 d
* '''Facility:''' [[Phoenix Base]]
* '''Engineer scope:''' Ship modules, defensive utilities, limpets, and Guardian technology
* '''Referral required:''' [[Lei Cheung]]
* '''System permit required:''' No

== Access requirements ==

Access to Ram Tah has three direct requirements:<ref name="inara-ram" /><ref name="edwiki-ram" />

# Reach '''Grade 3 access''' and progress at least one-third of the way toward Grade 4 with [[Lei Cheung]] to receive his referral.
# Reach the Pilots Federation '''Exploration rank of Surveyor''' or higher.
# Provide '''50 [[Classified Scan Databanks]]''' at Phoenix Base.

The referral reveals Ram Tah, but it does not satisfy the Exploration-rank or material requirements. Classified Scan Databanks are Encoded Engineering materials, not cargo commodities, and do not occupy cargo space.

For rank progression, material acquisition, and the complete ordered process, see [[Unlocking Ram Tah]].

== Workshop reputation ==

Reputation with Ram Tah increases by:<ref name="inara-ram" />

* crafting modifications at his workshop; or
* selling exploration data at Phoenix Base.

Higher reputation opens the grades that Ram Tah supports. INARA notes that station services may not appear immediately after the first unlock; beginning a new game session can make those services available.<ref name="inara-ram" />

The available modification families, effects, trade-offs, and recipes belong to [[Engineering Blueprints]]. Ram Tah's listed workshop services do not use the ordinary [[Experimental Effects|Experimental Effect]] system.

=== Operations-era Cargo Rack service ===

Operations added the '''Extended Cargo Rack''' blueprint for compatible Merc modules.<ref name="frontier-operations">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/updates/4-4-0-0 Elite Dangerous: Operations — Update Notes], Frontier Developments, 30 June 2026. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref> Ram Tah's current Engineer page and the individual blueprint page list him through Grade 4, while INARA's Engineer directory summary still labels his Cargo Rack service Grade 5.<ref name="inara-ram" /><ref name="inara-cargo">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/206/ Cargo Rack — Extended], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref><ref name="inara-engineers">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineers/ Engineers], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

The table uses Grade 4 because the specific current records agree at that grade. The discrepancy should be kept in mind until current in-game access or the data sources settle it.

=== Anti-Guardian Zone Resistance ===

Frontier's Update 18.07 states that Ram Tah can apply '''Anti-Guardian Zone Resistance''' to all Guardian modules without the former weapon-damage penalty.<ref name="frontier-agzr">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/update-notes/4-0-18-07 Elite Dangerous — 18.07 Update Notes], Frontier Developments. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

Ram Tah's current INARA record explicitly lists the Grade 1 modification for the Guardian Gauss Cannon, Guardian Plasma Charger, and Guardian Shard Cannon.<ref name="inara-ram" /> Frontier's wording is broader than that list, so commanders modifying another Guardian module should confirm that module's current in-game workshop entry before relying on the narrower table.

== Blueprint pinning and remote work ==

After sufficient reputation has been earned, one ordinary Ram Tah blueprint can be pinned for use through [[Remote Engineering]]. A pinned blueprint cannot exceed the grade he offers. Special Guardian work and other workshop-specific modifications may still require a visit to Phoenix Base.

== Referral branch ==

Ram Tah is currently the end of this Engineer referral branch; no outgoing Engineer referral is listed for him.<ref name="inara-engineers" /> Increasing his reputation still opens his higher workshop grades.

For the complete network, see [[Engineer Unlock Guide]].
